messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert P-87321 fired for service=redwood-infer-gpu, cluster=infer-west2a. symptom=GPU memory pressure, nvml reports repeated OOM-like errors and CUBLAS failures. sample log: `E nvml:alloc failed: out of memory`

pagerduty: PagerDuty: Incident P-87321 created (High) · auto-escalate in 5m if unacked. Runbook: /runbooks/gpu-memory-pressure

maya (oncall): acked. hopping on. quick status?

aj: seeing surge in kvcache evictions + per-gpu mem util ~98% on gpu-03a. spikes correlate with batch size 2048 on model-redwood-v2.

samir: confirmed nvml logs showing `CUBLAS_STATUS_ALLOC_FAILED` and `cudaErrorMemoryAllocation` across multiple workers in pool infer-west2a.

leo: customer telemetry -> 4.7% 5xx increase for embeddings route in last 2m. affected customers: acme-corp, shoply. CS alerting customers.

maya (oncall): plan: 1) reduce batch size for incoming routed jobs 2) temporarily disable prefetch/kvcache on pool 3) drain/evacuate noisy node gpu-03a if mem doesn't recover in 2m. executing step 1 now.

aj: reducing batch size via config: `POST /admin/pools/infer-west2a/config {"batch_size":512}` -> applied.

samir: disabling kv-prefetch on pool: `kubectl set env deploy/infer-worker -n infer KV_PREFETCH=false --selector=pool=infer-west2a`

incident-bot: action recorded: batch_size change and kv-prefetch toggle.

maya (oncall): evicting large KV entries on gpu-03a: `redis-cli -h 10.1.2.3 EVAL "return redis.call('FLUSHDB')" 0` (targeted cache replica). proceeding.

leo: monitoring: mem util dropped to 65% on gpu-03a after kv eviction. latency for embeddings improved slightly. customer error rate holding but trending down.

aj: running a graceful drain on worker node gpu-03a: `svcctl drain-node gpu-03a --grace 30s --route-fallback=model-redwood-v2-small`

pagerduty: PagerDuty: Incident P-87321 acknowledged by maya (oncall). escalation paused.

cs-bot: Noted CS: notified Acme about transient errors; they reported degraded throughput but no data loss.

samir: nvml logs still show occasional alloc failures, but frequency dropped ~90%. might be fragmentation, not pure demand. recommend compacting allocator or restart of process.

maya (oncall): opting for targeted restart of worker process on gpu-03a after drain completes. scheduling now. `kubectl rollout restart deploy/infer-worker -n infer --field-selector=spec.nodeName=gpu-03a`

aj: restart done. health checks passing. mem stable ~38-45% across pool.

leo: checking customer metrics: Acme error rate back to baseline, latencies normal.

maya (oncall): closing loop: re-enabled kv-prefetch with conservative limits, batch_size=1024 for infer-west2a. will follow up with a short postmortem and recommend quantized model variant for heavy batch jobs.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: Incident P-87321 resolved by maya (oncall). duration ~1m16s.

maya (oncall): thanks all. postmortem owners: samir + aj. immediate action items: - add allocator fragmentation metrics to GPU dashboards - add auto-compact/restart heuristic when fragmentation > 70% - notify product about recommending smaller default batch_size for embeddings route.

aj: noted, filing follow-up tickets.

samir: will grab logs and perf traces, put into incident folder.

leo: CS will send closure note to impacted customers. :white_check_mark:

maya (oncall): good work team.
